title: Try this Grandma's Hash Brown Casserole recipe; simple, delicious, and easy - NewsBreak
text:
12 hours ago Try the Grandma's Hash Brown Casserole recipe easy to make. Photo by Allrecipes/Captured image Some recipes stick around for good reason. This hash brown casserole from a Kentucky grandma proves that simple ingredients can create something special. It's the kind of dish that makes weeknight dinners easier and weekend gatherings more satisfying.
Inspired by a family recipe on Allrecipes, this casserole earned a 4.8-star rating from reviewers, and so we decided to give it a try. It's proof that creamy, cheesy potatoes topped with buttery cornflakes can work once you decide to think outside the box.
The beauty here is simplicity and adjustability. You mix frozen hash browns with Cheddar cheese, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, melted butter, and chopped onion. Season with salt and pepper. That's it. No fancy techniques or hard-to-find ingredients. Just real food that tastes like someone's grandma made it.
The cornflake topping makes this casserole stand out. I must admit, I have never tried anything like this before seeing this recipe. But the crushed flakes turn golden and crunchy in the oven, adding texture that balances the creamy base. Some folks swap in crushed Ritz crackers or potato chips instead. Both worked great in their review.
This recipe feeds twelve people, making it perfect for Florida families hosting cookouts or bringing a dish to share this holiday season. It also reheats well. Store leftovers in the fridge for up to four days, or freeze the whole thing for three months. You can even freeze it before baking if you want to prep ahead.
Kids love this casserole. It pairs well with grilled chicken, baked ham, or a simple green salad. Serve it at Sunday brunch or weeknight dinner after activities or practices. It fits anywhere you need comfort food that doesn't demand much effort.
I can say that this is a foolproof, budget-friendly, and delivers exactly what you want from a casserole: creamy, cheesy, satisfying goodness that everyone will eat.
Give this recipe a try today.
Ingredients
1 (2 pound) package frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup 2 cups shredded Cheddar cheese 1 (8 ounce) container sour cream 1 cup butter, melted, divided ½ cup chopped onion ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon ground black pepper 1 cup crushed cornflakes Directions and Instructions
Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Mix hash browns, Cheddar cheese, condensed soup, sour cream, ½ of the melted butter, onion, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Transfer mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle cornflakes on top, then drizzle with remaining melted butter. Bake in the preheated oven until casserole is bubbling around the edges and the top is golden brown, 1 hour to 1 hour 30 minutes. Serve and enjoy!
